# Akarsa Studio

> Akarsa Studio (Akarsa Studio Private Limited) is a brand, content and performance studio for luxury real estate and jewellery brands, working from Dubai and from its production studio in Vijay Nagar, Indore, India. It makes brand identities, films and content and runs Meta and Google campaigns, and has worked with 20+ brands including Starbucks, Adidas and Decathlon.
